headline: Spectacular turnaround at Poșta Română: record profit and revenues of almost 2 billion lei
summary: Poșta Română reported a record gross profit of 117 million lei and revenue of almost 2 billion lei in the first ten months of 2026. The state-owned postal operator cited its turnaround.
why: Poșta Română is Romania's national postal operator, and its results indicate the performance of state-owned enterprises in the country.
